text: Nothing is added; the whey sours by itself, either before or after it is mixed with water. No souring time, temperature, dilution ratio or species is given in the sources opened, so there is no table. Made for own use in Scotland, Iceland, the Faroes and Norway, never commercial, ended in the mid-20th century.

processing.text: Whey is left to sour by itself, before or after being diluted with water; it turns slightly alcoholic.
